say: Six pairs of shoes worth opening this Black Friday. I checked every price.
Emme Parsons, the Isabel mule in black calfskin. Was 665, now 399. Good for dinners when you still want to walk. Private sale ends December 2.
Also Emme Parsons: the Delicat sandal in black embossed snake, 645 down to 387. Good for weddings. Sizes are going, and it ends December 2.
Margaux, the Clara flat in wine calf, 345 before 20 percent off at checkout. Good for every day. It's their only sitewide sale of the year and it ends December 1.
Rothy's Penny Loafer in navy ReVelvet. Was 185, now 109, and every size was still there when I looked. Good for work. Ends December 1.
FRĒDA SALVADOR, the Nina riding boot in black Italian calf. Was 650, now 487. The harness strap comes off, so it's good for two looks. Ends December 2.
And FRĒDA's Eda d'Orsay sneaker in white calf, 298 down to 223. Good for people who live in white sneakers. Ends December 2.
Which pair would you open first?

recheck: Emme Parsons Isabel: the brand's own video shows a strap behind the heel, while the product text calls it a mule. Open the page and confirm the clip is the Isabel and whether 'mule' is the right word.
Emme Parsons: both pairs are tagged Exchange Only (no refunds). Delicat had only 6 of 13 sizes (37 to 39.5) and Isabel 8 of 13 when read.
Margaux: confirm the 20% comes off at checkout with no code and that the Clara in wine calf is included.
Rothy's Penny Loafer navy: confirm $109 and that all sizes are still in before saying so.
FRĒDA SALVADOR: confirm $487 and $223 show on the page without a code (the sheet also lists code VIPFRIDAY26 for 25% off) and that the sale ends Dec 2.
